item.title: Call for Entries: BreakOut West 2026
item.description: BreakOut West is a music industry showcase, conference, and festival, designed to match export-ready artists based in Western Canada with industry professionals. item.title: ShowHub: Connecting Vancouver’s Live Music Community
item.description: ShowHub is a centralized, accessible website that gathers and lists upcoming live music performances at small and mid-size venues across Vancouver and surrounding areas. It brings together information that’s often scattered across social media and individual websites, making it easy to see what’s happening on any given day. item.title: Apply to become a Music BC Juror in 2026
item.description: Music BC is seeking creative professionals and music industry representatives to join its juror roster for 2026. Selected jurors will provide insight and feedback on applications submitted to Music BC’s Travel Grant program. A juror honorarium will be provided. Applicants must reside in Canada. item.description: Vancouver, B.C. (February 5, 2026) – Today, the BC Arts Council and Creative BC are pleased to announce the recipients of their Interactive Fund partnership.
